info.title: Contact Form Server
info.description: Receives the Shopdaddy Studio custom-order form and sends it as an HTML email through Resend to the addresses in `MAIL_TO`, with the logo as an attachment and the visitor email as Reply-To. The server authenticates to Resend with `RESEND_API_KEY` from its own environment, so clients send no auth. Every response uses the envelope `{ success, data }` or `{ success, message, errors }`.

post.summary: Send the contact form by email
post.description:
Builds the email and sends it through Resend in one call. Nothing is stored.

| Email part | Value |
| --- | --- |
| From | `MAIL_FROM_NAME <MAIL_FROM_EMAIL>` |
| To | `MAIL_TO` |
| Reply-To | `email` |
| Subject | `New custom order request from <name>` |
| Body | `name`, `email`, `previousPage`, `terms`, `message`, `selectedProducts` (absolute store urls), `linkList`, submission time (UTC) |
| Attachment | `logo`, under its original file name |

name.description: Visitor name. Line breaks are collapsed into spaces; used in the email subject.

email.description: Visitor email; becomes the Reply-To of the email.

message.description: Free-text message, up to 10 000 characters. Line breaks are kept.

selectedProducts.description: JSON string of `[{ name, variant, url }]` exactly as the storefront form sends it (relative urls). Each url is resolved against `SHOPIFY_STORE_URL` and rendered as a "View product" button; a url pointing to another site is dropped. Items without a `name` are skipped.

linkList.description: JSON array of absolute http(s) urls the form collected (a single bare url is also accepted). Duplicates are dropped, each url must be at most 2048 characters and at most 128 urls are kept. Values that are not absolute http(s) urls are ignored.

logo.description: One file: EPS, AI, PSD, PDF, SVG, JPG/JPEG or PNG, max 20 MB. Attached to the email, never stored. Only this field accepts a file.

terms.description: Checkbox value, `on` when ticked. Rendered as Accepted / Not accepted.

previousPage.description: Hidden input with `document.referrer`. Only an absolute http(s) url is kept; rendered as "Came from".
